Generate C++ headers and sources from application inputs and fixed Crafts roots.

Usage:
  carven compile [options] <source-file>...

Output options:
  -o, --output-dir <dir>    Write files below <dir> (default: .)
      --stdout              Print generated files with path headings
      --linkage-domain=<id> Set the private namespace identity
                            (default: derived from the output directory)

Test options:
      --tests               Emit runtime tests, runner, and test entry
      --tests=default       Alias for --tests
      --tests=external      Emit runtime tests and runner without test entry
                            (default: no runtime test artifacts)

Options:
      --timings             Show total and stage timings on stderr
  -h, --help                Show this help

Sources include the fixed toolchain and working-directory Crafts roots.
C++ compilation and linking belong to the consuming build.
